claims.claim: Bounded pytest short test summary scanning correctly extracts allowlisted failed-node identities from summaries where the authentic final section begins beyond 65,536 characters, yielding a non-PASS PARTIAL result identical to shorter equivalents and preserving RUN-391-014 tail failures.

Verification summary preserves both nonempty stdout and stderr diagnostics, exposing lawful stderr-derived failed and error identities in safe projections without rerunning pytest, altering stdout/stderr raw framing, or misbinding evidence subject and command.

Projection deterministically returns at most 32 public node views in original observed order with honest nodes_truncated for 0, 1, 32, and 33+ records, never claiming complete pytest population from text summaries and distinguishing unparseable identities from zero-failure proofs.

Explicit diagnostic availability semantics distinguish unsupported formats, absent/malformed/truncated source, ERROR-only, stderr-only, and intentionally spoofed summary headers, replacing spoofed sections with authentic final pytest sections and avoiding silent empty labels.

All failure projections, Brain Sync, and attention views remain strictly bounded to allowlisted repository test identities and fixed error types, with raw output withheld and parameter values, credentials, tracebacks, and paths withheld.

V1/V2 public and private FAILURE schemas, immutable historical artifacts, Runtime verification ownership, self-host owner-gated detail, and Brain Sync consumers remain fully compatible without new lifecycle owners, automatic retries, or full-suite execution.
